notes: Redesign of 12 November 2026 (build contract, decisions 44 and 47). The page is a typeset menu with no photos and no cards. The ten services keep their names, their one line and their time, word for word as on the live Wix page (Kids’ Haircut keeps the curly apostrophe Wix uses). Every change of wording is on the fixed list of intended differences in qa/check_content.py, with the date and the reason. They are these. (1) The heading reads Our services, in sentence case (Wix has Our Services). (2) The services stand in the four groups of the design brief, Cut and style, Color, Smoothing and texture and Occasions, and no longer in the order of the Wix page. The four group names are new words. (3) Call for price is said once, at the top, and no longer in every service (Wix prints it in each of the ten cards). (4) The ten Book Now buttons are gone. One call block holds the Call button (Call 347-671-5095, it calls the number), the Text link (Text Gerta, it starts a text message to the same number) and the hours. (5) The closing line of the page (To book, call or text 347-671-5095, Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM.) is cut in two. Its first half stands at the top after Call for price, its hours stand in the call block.

The title tag is the live Wix title, unchanged. The meta description was changed on purpose on 2 November 2026, when online booking was dropped. The live Wix description was "Book hair and makeup appointments online with HairByGerta in Staten Island, NY. Reserve haircuts, color, balayage, keratin treatments, Brazilian blowouts and makeup in minutes." The new one is "Call or text to book hair and makeup appointments with Gerta in Staten Island, NY. Haircuts, color, balayage, keratin treatments, Brazilian blowouts and makeup." On the fixed list of intended differences.

call_block.call must show the phone number of content/site.json and call_block.hours must be the hours stored there, word for word. The generator stops when they are not. Where the Call button and the Text link lead comes from content/site.json (tel_href).

The page shows no photos, so the services have no image slots any more. Until 12 November 2026 each service card had a photo (svc-haircut, g10, makeup-red-lips, svc-bridal, foils-highlights, g19, g17, g16, g14, g18, all placeholders). Eight of them are also places of the Gallery page. svc-haircut and svc-bridal were shown on this page only, so no page shows them now. Their files stay in the folder images.

When a service is renamed, added or removed, change the list of the home page too (content/home.json, services.groups). seo/jsonld-home.json lists the ten services for search engines and is a file of its own.
